reviewStandard: All six routes fail the pre-generation causal-evidence, compartment, signal-circuit, riboswitch-class, metabolic-network, or low-biomass-specimen gate. They receive no marked prompt, generation call, or raster.
promotionRule: No Batch 090 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its molecule, compartment, signal circuit, RNA class, substrate pathway, specimen method, measurement, endpoint, and evidence conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: An exact molecule is surrounded by generalized human ASD causation, concentration, taxon, diet, metal-synergy, and intervention claims extrapolated from heterogeneous evidence.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Separate acid/salts, compartments, microbial pathways, measurements, animal exposure models, human associations, and interventions with dose, matrix, assay, population, endpoint, and tier.

routeDecisions.reason: An exact molecule is embedded in a universal peripheral-to-central dysbiosis, cytokine, serotonin, excitotoxicity, and multi-disease chain without concentration or compartment boundaries.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define molecular species, compartment, producing cell/enzymes, concentration and assay, model, receptor/endpoint, cohort, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: AHL, peptide, AI-2, indole, and fungal systems, organisms, environmental contexts, outputs, and inhibition strategies are generalized as one density switch.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by named signal, synthase, receptor, organism, concentration/diffusion context, regulated target, assay, phenotype, and intervention.

routeDecisions.reason: Diverse metabolite and ion-sensing RNA classes, architectures, genomic contexts, ligands, kinetics, and outputs are collapsed into a universal metal-sensing model.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by class and exact sequence/organism, genomic context, ligand, structure accession, expression platform, kinetic regime, assay, target gene, and phenotype.

routeDecisions.reason: Carbohydrate fermentation is labeled uniformly beneficial and protein fermentation uniformly toxic while substrates, organisms, cross-feeding, products, spatial gradients, diets, and endpoints are conflated.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Create substrate–organism–pathway–product modules with location, flux/concentration, assay, diet, host/model, comparator, endpoint, and certainty.

routeDecisions.reason: Core taxa, dysbiosis, metal selection, sperm effects, and probiotic promise are asserted without specimen, contamination-control, microbial-load, viability, method, or cohort boundaries.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define specimen, collection, negative controls, extraction, sequencing workflow, host depletion, absolute load, viability, cohort, phenotype, covariates, and replicated evidence.
